items.title: 'Dish Was Prepared Using...': Bengaluru Airport Responds After Flyer Reports Maggots' In Lounge Food
items.why: Lounge food safety incidents can damage perceived value of card lounge perks; monitor operator quality controls.
items.summary_ai: A passenger reported maggots in food served at a Bengaluru airport lounge, and the airport has issued a response.
items.take: Lounge food safety incidents can damage perceived value of card lounge perks; monitor operator quality controls.
